name: Request Validation
sourceRefs: Stedi (stedi.com/edi/x12-005010/segment/AAA) — X12 005010 AAA segment element reference. Modeled maxUse='>1': the HIPAA-specific 271 (005010X279A1) guide (stedi.com/edi/edi/hipaa/transaction-set/271-B1) explicitly places AAA up to 9 times at multiple levels (2000A, 2100A, 2100B, 2100C, 2100D, 2110C, 2110D) — a real rejection can carry more than one reason at once. AAA01='N' + AAA03 (Reject Reason Code) is how a 271 signals a request-validation failure (e.g. subscriber not found, invalid/missing name) — a structural fact this engine maps through, never decides.
